sloka: शिवः सर्वेषु कालेषु काननेभ्यो विनिह्सृतः ।राघवम् युक्त शीत उष्णः सेविष्यति सुखो अनिलः ॥२-४४-९॥
transliteration: śivaḥ sarveṣu kāleṣu kānanebhyo vinihsṛtaḥ ।rāghavam yukta śīta uṣṇaḥ seviṣyati sukho anilaḥ ॥2-44-9॥

translations.english: A pleasant yet moderately hot and cold breeze blowing through the woodlands will serve Rama at all seasons.
